md_s050_r0005_requirement.text: It may differ from a historical publication when the selected cutoff, approved as-known configuration, or declared scenario differs. It creates new replay artifacts and never mutates or impersonates the original publication.
md_s050_r0005_requirement.clause_1_bounded_difference: an as-known result may differ from a historical publication ONLY for the named causes (cutoff, approved as-known configuration, declared scenario); a difference with no such cause is a divergence the comparison must catch. Proving it needs an as-known replay that actually executes its comparison: a MISMATCH/FAIL for an unexplained divergence and a PASS for the as-known expectation it is built from.
md_s050_r0005_requirement.clause_2_no_impersonation: creates new replay artifacts, never mutates or impersonates the publication: PROVEN today (B18AsKnownModeIsolationTest::test_an_as_known_result_claims_no_publication_and_records_its_own_mode)
md_s050_r0005_requirement.identity_that_must_be_as_known: every bound input of Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md:21-31, including the reason registry version (:30), resolved as known by the cutoff (Platform_Config_Registry_LOCKED.md:289; Determinism_Invariants_LOCKED.md:122), never current state (:291)
md_s050_r0005_requirement.required_refusal: a missing bound input is BLOCKED, not permission to query current/latest state (Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md:33)
md_s050_r0005_requirement.why_clause_1_is_unreachable: AsKnownReplaySnapshotService::capture() sets reason_registry_hash to the REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE marker unconditionally, and ReplayVerificationService::verifyAsKnownAgainstFixture returns BLOCKED on that marker before any comparison; no fixture content can reach comparison

root_cause.classification: IMPLEMENTATION GAP + PROOF GAP (not an authority gap)
root_cause.correction_of_the_earlier_reading: E-MD-B18-A002-071/073 and the code comments say the gap is that MD-S085 (Reason_Codes_Registry.md) defines no revision or version concept. That is true of MD-S085, but MD-S082 (Platform_Config_Registry_LOCKED.md) already places the reason registry version in the immutable, bitemporal configuration snapshot: ":66 data-usability decision/reason registry versions" and ":79 contamination horizons and reason-code registry version" are output-affecting key families, and "The snapshot includes every applicable key in these families" (:46). The snapshot has effective and recorded/known timestamps and a content hash (:13-19), and as-known replay "resolves only revisions known by the declared knowledge cutoff, then freezes a new replay snapshot" (:289). AS_KNOWN already takes its formula registry identity from the cutoff-resolved snapshot. The authority therefore defines where an as-known reason-registry identity comes from; what is missing is the snapshot member itself.
root_cause.implementation_gap: no configuration snapshot carries a reason-registry version: the resolved-key register has no such key, MarketDataSemanticBindings has none, and AsKnownReplaySnapshotService reads governance.reason_registry_revision, a key that never existed
root_cause.proof_gap_in_a_closed_stage: MD-S082-R0036 and MD-S082-R0044 are SATISFIED for MD-B04 (E-MD-B04-A002-001) on the generic configuration-foundation guard pair (MarketDataConfigFoundationProofGate maps every MD-S082 row to the same family methods), not on a guard that the snapshot carries a reason-registry version, which it does not. Recorded as F-MD-B18-A002-034; B04 state is not changed here.
root_cause.publication_path_contrast: PUBLICATION_EXACT binds real reason-registry content: ProducerRegistrySnapshot::capture() hashes the eod_reason_codes entries at run time into the frozen registry_versions component, and the V2 identity is the semantic content of code, category, description, severity (D-MD-B18-A002-014 Q4 = A). For a historical cutoff the producer already records missing path registry_versions.reason_registry.authoritative_known_at_cutoff.

why_an_owner_decision_is_still_required: the authority selects the location (the configuration snapshot) but implementing it has consequences that no current record authorizes:

1. every new configuration snapshot changes content and hash; config_content_hash enters the V2 artifact hashes, so a world built after the change no longer matches the owner-approved candidate-v4 (D-MD-B18-A002-016 is exact-fingerprint and exact-build bound): the MD-S003-R0025 basis proven by E-MD-B18-A002-105 would need a candidate-v5, independent review and owner approval cycle

2. the change sits on a closed stage (MD-B04) whose MD-S082-R0036/R0044 are SATISFIED on a basis that does not prove them (F-MD-B18-A002-034); correcting that is a successor attempt of a closed stage, which is not started by assumption

3. whether the member is a derived snapshot member (like the compiled semantic_bindings, no resolved-key register row) or a registered key (a controlled correction of the LOCKED register) is not stated by MD-S082
4. materially different alternatives remain that trade conformance to MD-S082 against blast radius

owner_decision_Q9.question: How does an AS_KNOWN replay bind the reason-registry identity required by Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md:30, and under which governed route and sequencing?

A.name: Configuration-snapshot member, as MD-S082 states (RECOMMENDED)
A.semantic_meaning: every new immutable configuration snapshot carries the content-addressed identity of the governed reason registry (canonical entries code, category, description, severity, is_active; the D-MD-B18-A002-014 Q4 = A content); AS_KNOWN binds the member of the snapshot resolved for the trade date as known at the cutoff; a snapshot without the member is BLOCKED (fail closed, like CONFIG_UNBOUND)
A.authority_impact: none if the member is a derived snapshot member (A1); a controlled correction adding one row to the MD-S082 resolved-key register if the owner prefers a registered key (A2)
A.implementation_impact: MarketDataConfigSnapshotRepository / snapshot payload (MD-B04 surface); AsKnownReplaySnapshotService and the verifier (MD-B18); a recorded_at for a registry change is the creation time of the first snapshot that carries it
A.proof_impact: MD-S050-R0005 becomes provable: an as-known replay executes its comparison; an unexplained divergence is MISMATCH/FAIL and the permitted differences are labelled; MD-S050-R0014 and MD-S019-R0071 then need their own binding and reproducibility probes
A.historical_compatibility: already-created snapshots and sealed publications are not rewritten; as-known replays whose cutoff resolves a pre-change snapshot stay BLOCKED for this input (honest, never back-filled from current state)
A.b10_b17_b18_impact: B04: successor attempt to make MD-S082-R0036/R0044 true; B10: no producer change, but new snapshots change config_content_hash values in V2 artifact and manifest hashes (goldens that seal through the runtime resolver must be re-derived, not edited); B17: none found; B18: R0025 needs candidate-v5 + independent review + owner approval because the approved candidate is build- and config-bound
A.complexity_risk: moderate: one snapshot member, one reader; the governance risk is the re-derivation of R0025, which must be sequenced deliberately

B.name: Revisioned reason registry (MD-S085 versioning)
B.semantic_meaning: the reason registry gets immutable revisions with recorded/effective time; AS_KNOWN resolves the revision known at the cutoff
B.authority_impact: controlled correction of MD-S085 (revision and time concepts) and still a snapshot selector for MD-S082
B.implementation_impact: new revision table, seeding and migration discipline for every reason-code change, resolver, AS_KNOWN binding
B.historical_compatibility: no revision history exists before introduction: earlier cutoffs stay BLOCKED
B.b10_b17_b18_impact: as A, plus a new registry lifecycle owned by B04
B.complexity_risk: high; duplicates what the configuration snapshot already provides

C.name: Capture-derived identity (deviation)
C.semantic_meaning: AS_KNOWN binds the reason-registry content captured with the latest run capture recorded at or before the cutoff (the content PUBLICATION_EXACT already freezes)
C.authority_impact: an interpreting decision or controlled correction is needed because MD-S082 places registry versions in the snapshot, not in run captures; MD-S082-R0036/R0044 stay separately unmet
C.implementation_impact: AsKnownReplaySnapshotService and the verifier only (B18); no snapshot change
C.historical_compatibility: needs a capture at or before the cutoff; registry changes between runs are invisible until the next run
C.b10_b17_b18_impact: no config hash change: R0025 candidate-v4 stays valid; B04 truth problem (F-034) unaddressed
C.complexity_risk: low code risk, real conformance risk: it leaves a LOCKED rule unimplemented and chooses a second source of registry truth

D.name: Narrow the MD-S050-R0005 proof shape (authority change)
D.semantic_meaning: accept the bounded-difference clause without an executed as-known comparison
D.assessment: this weakens the governed requirement: the clause only has content if a divergence can be caught; with every as-known replay BLOCKED the platform cannot answer the as-known question at all, and the LOCKED single-mode section says such claims are unavailable rather than untested. It would be an authority change, not a test correction, and it settles neither MD-S050-R0014 nor MD-S019-R0071, whose wording requires binding the version. NOT RECOMMENDED.

owner_decision_Q9.sub_question: If A: A1 (derived snapshot member, no register row) or A2 (registered key via a controlled correction), and whether the R0025 re-derivation (candidate-v5) is accepted now or sequenced after the remaining B18 bases

recommendation: A (A1), sequenced as: owner decision -> MD-B04 successor attempt for the snapshot member and MD-S082-R0036/R0044 truth -> MD-B18 AS_KNOWN binding and the MD-S050-R0005 / R0014 / R0071 proofs -> R0025 candidate-v5 re-derivation, review and approval. Basis: it implements a LOCKED rule that already exists, binds historical content-addressed truth from an immutable bitemporal record, reuses the D-MD-B18-A002-014 identity, keeps AS_KNOWN consistent with how it already binds the formula registry, and never reads current state. The cost (R0025 re-derivation) is the honest consequence of a config-bound golden, not a reason to choose a deviation.
